note: THE CONTROL beside the divergence next door. Emacs answers (nil t t): the GLOBAL value of `lexical-binding' is nil even in an Emacs that is evaluating this lexically, because the `t' a file sees is a per-file binding over it. kg's global is nil too and its `defvar' marks the symbol special, so all three elements agree -- which is what makes u1a-lexical-binding-is-nil-in-kg attributable to kg's DIALECT and not to a missing variable.
